chunks: And Hammad narrated from al-Halabi, from Abu Abdullah عليه السلام:
Regarding a man who married off his slave woman to another man, then had intercourse with her, he said: “He is to be subjected to the hadd punishment.”

key_terms.زَوَّجَ أَمَتَهُ: he married off his slave woman

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a man marries his slave woman to someone else and then has intercourse with her?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a man who marries his slave woman to another man and then has intercourse with her himself. Imam Abu Abdullah عليه السلام rules that such an act necessitates the hadd punishment, indicating the legal seriousness of violating the marital bond established for her.
